placements.why: The segment mandates recurring rollback rehearsals and elevates rehearsal to a constitutive test of capability — this names an organizational category (practices that prove operational readiness through exercise) that nothing in the empty strata yet holds.
placements.title: operational capabilities must be rehearsed to be real
placements.frame: What organizational practices ensure that claimed capabilities are actually deliverable under live conditions?

placements.title: unrehearsed capability is no capability
placements.frame: Is an unrehearsed capability being equated with not having that capability at all — making rehearsal the constitutive proof of possession?
placements.why: Quinton's aphorism — 'a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have' — states a thematic principle true beyond this single decision: that an unexercised operational capability is equivalent to its absence. The monthly cadence mandate is the commissive act that operationalizes the principle, but the principle itself is the thematic grain future envelopes about drills, rehearsals, and capability verification will keep feeding. No existing leaf holds this; the graph is empty.
